assignments.name: facts
assignments.value: Repairs carry an $89 diagnostic fee (waived for Care Club members; applied to the repair if approved). New-install estimates (e.g. furnace or AC replacement) are free with a written quote. Hours are Monday-Saturday 7am-7pm, plus 24/7 emergency service. Service area is the Greater Portland metro. The Care Club maintenance plan is $19/month. Main phone: (555) 010-4729. Services: HVAC, plumbing, electrical.
